questions.question: At which ground did Kayla Ferreira record their career-best bowling figures (2-35, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Knights on 2021/03/05.

questions.question: "Lions" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: Both Central Gauteng and Gauteng were folded into the Lions.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Warriors or Heat?
How many wickets separate the all-time #1 (Leah Jones) and #2 (Jané Winster) wicket-takers (combined T20 + List A) in the 22/23 season?
questions.explanation: Leah Jones: 26 — Jané Winster: 25 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Annerie Dercksen or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Annerie Dercksen: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Runs' in the 23/24 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 464.
